frontiers.title: Question generation
frontiers.question: What makes an internally generated question worth pursuing when no external task requires it?

frontiers.title: Hypothesis revision
frontiers.question: How should earlier hypotheses change when new evidence conflicts with them?

frontiers.title: Memory abstraction
frontiers.question: Can repeated episodes be compressed into reusable concepts without losing important exceptions?

frontiers.title: Multi-step planning
frontiers.question: Can an autonomous project preserve a coherent objective across several generations and adapt its plan from evidence?

rule: When Layer 1 is healthy, choose epistemic/capability questions; operational continuity is out of scope unless new evidence makes it relevant.
